name: TrackSSL
description: SSL/TLS certificate monitoring for public and internal/private certs. It alerts on upcoming expiry, failed renewal automation, cert changes and fraudulent certs. Free tier, then from $0.72 per domain. Founded Jun 2017, US.

mentions.evidence: ~$5,294 MRR, 221 active subscriptions, ~$4,338 L30, ~$191,420 all-time, ~86% L30 profit margin. Revenue synced Oct 6, 2026 ~06:41 Warsaw (04:41 UTC). TrustMRR "estimated users" 23,000 (founder-stated).
mentions.indieAngle: "Expiry monitoring" for anything with a renewal date that breaks business if missed: domains, SSL, Apple/Google push certs, SAML signing certs, EU qualified e-signature certs, KSeF tokens. Per-item pricing, agency plans, Slack/Teams alerts.

whyItPrints: Pure "insurance" utility: nobody thinks about it until a cert expires and the site goes down. Agencies with hundreds of client domains pay per domain forever. Public cert lifetimes are scheduled to drop to 47 days by 2029 ([CA/B Forum ballot SC-081](https://cabforum.org/2025/04/11/ballot-sc081v3-introduce-schedule-of-reducing-validity-and-data-reuse-periods/)), so more renewals means more chances for automation to fail.
